metadata.title: Mohammad Ali Portfolio
metadata.description: Portfolio for showcasing projects and skills.

hero.name: Mohammad Ali
hero.description: I enjoy coding and creating things that make a difference

description: Front-End Developer focused on building high-performance, scalable, and user-friendly web and mobile applications. Skilled in React, React Native, and Next.js, with expertise in state management, UI/UX improvement, and performance optimization for seamless digital experiences.

Passionate about clean code, emerging technologies, and solving complex problems. Enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to create innovative, intuitive solutions that drive measurable impact.

projects.title: BlueID – Digital Identity & Verification Platform
projects.description: Led the front-end development and deployment pipeline for BlueID, a digital identity and verification platform enabling businesses to securely authenticate users and perform real‑time validations. Built with React, Vite, and TypeScript, featuring responsive UI for identity verification, academic validation, and cloud digital signature workflows. Set up full CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and configured production servers to ensure fast and reliable releases.

projects.title: Marzia Portfolio – UX/UI Designer Portfolio
projects.description: Developed a multilingual portfolio for a UX/UI designer using Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Features smooth page transitions via Framer Motion, internationalization with EN / ES / IT using next-intl, responsive design, and project case studies. Integrated Swiper.js for carousels and Calendly for direct scheduling, ensuring a visually polished and user-focused experience.

projects.title: QTFix – Instantly Fix Wrong Keyboard Text
projects.description: Developed a modern Chrome extension to instantly fix Persian ↔ English text typed with the wrong keyboard, usable anywhere you type. Allows customizable keyboard shortcuts, supports RTL/LTR mixed texts, converts both ways (English ↔ Persian) instantly, and works fully offline for privacy. Built with Vite, React, and TypeScript for the popup UI, and plain JavaScript for background and content scripts. Fully open‑source and MIT licensed.

projects.title: GitHub Contribution Graph Generator
projects.description: Built a web application to create custom GitHub‑style contribution graphs and generate a bash script that fakes commits. Features interactive grid editing, smart date handling with date‑fns, and script generation with custom author name/email. Developed with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, and deployed on GitHub Pages for instant access.

projects.title: Fractalwise – AI & Data Analytics Landing Page
projects.description: Designed and developed a responsive landing page for Fractalwise, an AI and data analytics company specializing in educational institutions. The page highlights services such as advanced data analytics, interactive dashboards, data governance, and behavioral data analysis. Built with modern web technologies for optimal performance, accessibility, and SEO, ensuring a clean user experience to attract and engage target audiences.

projects.title: Stuff Happens – Single-Player Ranking Game
projects.description: Developed a full-stack single-player web game inspired by 'Stuff Happens' as part of a university project. Implemented with React 19 (SPA), Vite, Tailwind CSS, and dnd-kit for the frontend, Node.js 22 with Express and Passport.js for the backend, and SQLite for persistent storage. Features secure authentication, demo mode for guests, game history tracking, and drag‑and‑drop card placement. Optimized for performance, code clarity, and best development practices.

projects.title: InsideBox - Cross-platform QR Code Manager
projects.description: Developed a cross-platform mobile application using Expo and React Native to manage QR codes, photos, and notes. Features include offline support, dark mode, data backup/restore, localization, and label printing.

projects.title: Blackjack Game Application
projects.description: Developed a cross-platform Blackjack game using React Native and Expo. Integrated real-time gameplay with WebSocket and provided a seamless user experience.

projects.title: Gonbad Kabud - Kids' Interactive Learning App
projects.description: An interactive learning and storybook app for children. Features animations, story-driven activities, and parental controls for a secure and educational experience.

projects.title: Rekasb Website and Plugin Development
projects.description: Developed a professional website and WordPress plugin for seamless integration with React applications. The project aimed to streamline the user experience and enhance accessibility.

projects.title: Freelancer Web Bot
projects.description: Developed an automated web bot to assist freelancers in managing tasks efficiently. Features include task scheduling, data scraping, and seamless integrations with freelancing platforms.

projects.title: Charsoq - Maris Application Development
projects.description: Contributed to the development and maintenance of the Maris application for Charsoq, a data-driven marketing agency specializing in the pharmaceutical industry. Responsibilities included fixing critical bugs, optimizing background geolocation tracking, enhancing UI/UX, upgrading libraries, and implementing requested features using React Native and Next.js.

projects.title: KTT Company Website
projects.description: Developed a responsive and modern website for Tolou Taban Company (KTT), established in 2008. The site highlights the company’s expertise in infrastructure projects, industrial kitchen consulting, and human resource solutions. Focused on delivering a user-friendly experience to showcase their diverse services, including construction, waste management, and restaurant operations.

projects.title: Pezeshket - Telehealth & Medical Consultation Platform
projects.description: Played a key role in developing and optimizing Pezeshket, the largest online health consultation platform for Persian speakers. Built the Progressive Web App (PWA) using React for a seamless web experience and developed the mobile application using React Native for cross-platform accessibility. Focused on enhancing UI/UX, improving performance, and ensuring smooth real-time interactions for users and healthcare professionals.
